notes: Timeline = gapless mp3 decode (ffmpeg/libsndfile/browsers); Demucs stems were shifted -23.0 ms (LAME encoder delay assumption, carried from the reference project — re-verify by click correlation before sample-accurate claims) to match. Tempo is constant: 104.167 BPM (period 0.57600 s), fitted over the whole song on drum+mix onset envelopes; phase refined on kick attack times; first beat 0.288 s. The grid is extrapolated through drum-less passages and the fade. Bar phase: chosen automatically (phase 0) from sung-line starts landing on bar lines (this track has no backbeat snare — mid-band attacks are uniform across 8ths, verified in the build log), confirmed against spectral-flux section-novelty peaks. First downbeat 0.288 s. Sections start on downbeats at/before the first sung word of each [Header] section in song/lyrics.txt (0 snares, 353 kicks, 455 hats detected). Envelopes: 100 fps, frame i centred at i/100 s, 46 ms RMS window, one-pole smoothing (10 ms attack / 90 ms release), each divided by its own 99th percentile and clipped to 0..1 (linear amplitude). low <150 Hz, mid 150-2000 Hz, high >4 kHz of the full mix; vocal/drums/bass/other = stem RMS. Onsets [time, strength 0-1] from the drums stem: kick = attack of the <120 Hz band; snare = 1.5-5 kHz attacks with qualifying noise tail; hat = >7 kHz attacks away from snares/kicks. vocal = note onsets from the vocal stem (log-mel flux peaks + legato pitch jumps > 0.8 semitone).
